name: CUHK03
description: Person re-identification dataset with labeled and detected bounding boxes, 1,467 identities, about 14k images, and a 100-trial Rank-1 evaluation protocol. Use is subject to CUHK terms; no data is vendored.
citation: CUHK03: A new dataset and benchmark for person re-identification. Li et al., NIPS 2014 workshop.
